# m.forex.conversion

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

An amount converted between two currencies at the latest quote.

Call it from a session `m`:

```python
m.forex.conversion(from_currency, to_currency, *, amount=1.0, precision=2)
```

- Query methods: `fetch()`, `poll()`
- Read from: REST
- `poll()` by default: `dm.PollMode.REPLACE`, which holds only the latest poll's rows, one row per `Symbol`
- `poll(mode=dm.PollMode.APPEND)`: appends each new state of a row, identified by `Symbol` and `LastTimestamp`

[Dataset index](README.md)

## Arguments

| Argument | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `from_currency` | The currency to convert from, a three-letter code such as `"AUD"`, written exactly: upper case, nothing around it. |
| `to_currency` | The currency to convert to, such as `"USD"`. |
| `amount` | The amount to convert, a positive, finite `int` or `float`; 1.0 by default. |
| `precision` | The decimal places of the result, 0 to 4; 2 by default. |

## Plans

How recent the data is on each of Massive's plans, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Currency Conversion (REST) |
| --- | --- |
| Currencies Basic | Not included |
| Currencies Starter | Real-time |
| Currencies Business | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST `symbol`: "The symbol pair that was evaluated from the request." |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. |
| `Converted` | double | The result of the conversion. |
| `From` | String | The "from" currency symbol. |
| `InitialAmount` | double | The amount to convert. |
| `LastBid` | double | The bid price. From the `last` object: Contains the requested quote data for the specified forex currency pair. |
| `LastAsk` | double | The ask price. From the `last` object: Contains the requested quote data for the specified forex currency pair. |
| `LastExchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/forex/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. From the `last` object: Contains the requested quote data for the specified forex currency pair. |
| `LastTimestamp` | Instant | The Unix millisecond timestamp. From the `last` object: Contains the requested quote data for the specified forex currency pair. |
| `To` | String | The "to" currency symbol. |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. |
